name: Travis County, TX
findings: Travis County has 5,219 nonprofit organizations. 2,382 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,979 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Travis County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 77 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 29 in similar places of this size.
